subject: Forecasting at Lumen
body:
Hi Priya,

Your profile says the Head of Data at Lumen Grocers leads forecasting and reporting. That means you own how the whole company plans stock.

At Fernleaf Grocers I rebuilt demand forecasting at store-zone level, and stockouts in new zones fell from 11% to 6% in one quarter.

Would a 15 minute call next week be useful? If someone else owns this hire, a name is plenty.

Thanks,
